review_method: Independent semantic reading of this immutable cohort only; no old review, other reviewer output, author patch, or validator verdict used to assign approval. limitations: Static content and declared screen contract only. No actual UI, family test, Chrome voice test, or hearing/playback test performed.
The declared contract prefers Google same-language browser voices with ko/ja-only installed fallback, prohibits R2 audio, and retains legacy 410. No live implementation verification claimed.
Dictionary/source facts were inspected from the frozen evidence; no fresh remote retrieval, Production/Preview write, database change, build, or full test suite performed.
